The Oppo Find N2 is a foldable smartphone developed by Oppo, officially announced on December 15, 2022 at INNO Day 2022.[1] It is Oppo's second foldable smartphone, and a successor to Oppo Find N.[2][3]

Design

With dimensions of 132.2 × 140.5 × 7.4 mm (unfolded) and 132.2 × 72.6 × 14.6 mm (folded) respectively, the height is slightly taller than the iPhone 13 mini.[4]
